title: Arca/arca_config: migrate scripts/, upstream of arca_cli
objective:
Migrate Arca/arca_config (`~/Devel/prj/Arca/arca_config`, elixir) onto devbin -- a published library, recently active, and upstream of BOTH arca_cli and Multiplyer via their GitHub branch deps. Drift risk is low; semver discipline is the point.

**RECLASSIFIED mid-WP, 2026-08-10.** Planned as a fresh install; it is a migration. `scripts/` is hv's older, pre-devbin launcher convention, and the ST0002 survey missed it in four of six projects by searching for the first fleet's `bin/<prj>` shape. This WP is where that was found, so it also runs the migration protocol (inventory -> ACs before code -> install alongside -> equivalence -> delete last) rather than the fresh-install one, and AC-02.4 to AC-02.6 were added when the shape changed.

**Runs second in the thread** (hv, 2026-08-10), ahead of Multiplyer rather than behind it, because everything downstream of it should resolve once against a settled state.
body:
## Deliverables

- Fence, one install commit, doctor green, `help --why` accounted
- Baseline -> `mix deps.update --all` -> green, per the WP-01 protocol, seals as the record
- Any dep resolution that would move the public API: surfaced to hv, not taken
- Inventory with a disposition per retired script; equivalence proven; `scripts/` deleted last
- `config.yaml` + authored help in their own commits

## Dependencies

- WP-04 (the proven deps-drift protocol -- WP-01 no longer precedes this one)
